title: Spiders and their webs
examples: How many legs do spiders have?
What is spider silk used for?
Does a spider build its web in one piece?

explain.say: A spider has eight legs. Count them: there are four on each side.
Spiders make silk inside their bodies. Spiders spin the silk into webs.
A spider uses its web to catch food. The web is sticky.
A spider can hang from a line of silk. This keeps it safe.
You can see spider webs in gardens. Small insects get caught in them.
Spiders use silk for more than webs. They make safety lines and egg sacs.

draw.text: Silk used for more than webs.

faq.a: No, some spiders do not build webs at all. They might hunt on the ground instead.

faq.q: How strong is the silk they spin?
faq.a: Spider silk is very strong for how thin and light it is.
asks: What is the strength of spider silk?

faq.a: Spiders mainly eat small insects and other tiny creatures. They catch them in their web.
asks: Does a spider eat big things?

faq.q: How many legs do spiders have?
faq.a: Spiders always have eight legs. This is different from insects which have six legs.
asks: How many legs on a spider?
Does a spider have six or eight legs?

faq.q: Can spiders spin silk for other things?
faq.a: Yes. They use silk to make safety lines and to wrap their eggs.
asks: What else is silk used for?

facts: Spiders have eight legs, unlike insects which have six.
They produce silk from special glands in their bodies.
The web is used to trap small prey like flies and moths.
Spider silk is known for being very strong and light.

quiz.say: Count the legs. How many legs does a spider have?
quiz.why: A spider has eight legs, four on each side.

wrong.1: Six legs is an insect, and a spider is different.
wrong.2: Ten is two too many, so count again.

quiz.say: What does a spider use its web for?
quiz.why: Small insects get stuck on the sticky web. The spider eats them.

wrong.0: A web is full of holes, so it keeps nothing warm.
wrong.2: Spiders use webs on land, in gardens and houses.

quiz.say: A spider hangs from a branch. What holds it up?
quiz.why: A spider spins a strong line of silk and hangs from it.

wrong.0: A spider makes its own line, so it needs no stick.
